RPM_DEFICIT.meaning: the RPM telemetry implies less thrust than the command (VIOLATED), or not (NOMINAL): the local ESC-monitor symptom. It does not say whether the rotor or the RPM channel is at fault

expected_inputs: stage1_evidence.plan for the variant and checkpoint
fault_behavior: a statistic that cannot be computed is NOT_APPLICABLE (xsys_v2_adapter._state_from)
validity_rule: the window XSYS-001 validated this witness in (xsys_features.WINDOWS); content time is the window's end
